review.notes: Full review of the 5568-line README and Suggested.lean. Previous findings R01-R05, R07 and R09 are repaired; R06 and R08 are partly repaired and re-raised as R03 and R04. R01 (P2): IsCIso/IsCEpi restate Mathlib's ObjectProperty.isoModSerre/epiModSerre (equivalence proved by one term on a scratch copy; the repaired hurewicz statement elaborates). P3: the Serre spectral sequence is absent from the docstring's headline accounting; three owned theorems lack locators; the native pi1-action on pi_n is uncited; process words and undefined abbreviations (AT/DG/GT, milestone, acceptance). Seeded sample of 15 targets verified against Hatcher, SSAT, Strom, KMR, Milnor, VBKT, Stacks, FTW, Moore and May (5.0's Weibel is uncertified). Gate passes; depcheck: 236 roadmaps, 2182 edges, 0 problems; lake env lean on Suggested.lean gives only the 20 sorry warnings; 396 README names resolved at the pins; adversarial table of 41 rows (plus header) with computed values.
